evidence.source_sentence: Zeta potential measurements were carried out on pulverized samples suspended in electrolytic solutions (0.01 wt.%) using a Zeta Sizer 3 (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, Worcestershire, UK). The velocity of the particles in an electric field of 100 V was measured by Laser Doppler Anemometry using a He/Ne laser beam. The simple Smoluchowski equation which allows to calculate zeta potential values from the electrophoretic mobilities - was used:

evidence.source_sentence: The amidine group content of the polymers was determined by potentiometric titration using a Mettler DL 70 titrator (electrode Mettler DG 113-SC). A total of 100 mg of polyamidine were dissolved in 40 ml ethanol (1f–1g) or DMSO (1a–1e) and titrated with 1 N aqueous HCl standard solution.
